sourceLabel: FHFA Annual Census Tract House Price Index (developmental, not seasonally adjusted)

methodology.geography: Exact census tracts are joined to the same directional clusters used by the ACS map
methodology.aggregation: Population-weighted mean of observed tract-level annual HPI changes, chained into a cluster index and rebased to 2000=100 when available
methodology.momentumScore: 50% latest YoY percentile, 25% three-year CAGR percentile, 15% five-year growth percentile, 10% YoY acceleration percentile
methodology.competency: 70% latest population coverage plus 30% completeness across the latest ten annual observations
methodology.limitation: FHFA tract HPI is developmental and available only where repeat mortgage transactions support an index; coverage is shown for every cluster
